channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro na pesquisa para presidente: veja números recentes
item.description: Recent polls for the 2026 presidential election show Lula (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) leading in voter intention, though numbers vary across institutes and scenarios tested. The race is still in its early stages with significant room for shifts in electoral dynamics.

item.title: Michelle publica vídeo convocando apoio do Éxercito Rosa a Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro led a campaign organized by PL Mulher to support PL Senate candidate Flávio Bolsonaro for the Federal District, featuring videos from female party representatives. The first video was presented by Priscila Costa from Ceará, alongside supporters from multiple states, despite internal disagreements. Michelle takes on this role after stepping down from PL Mulher leadership in June.

item.title: Caiado celebra Moraes fora do inquérito das fake news
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado praised Edson Fachin's decision to remove Alexandre de Moraes from the fake news inquiry, calling it a positive step and proper for the STF.

item.title: Governo estima gastar R$ 7 bi no mês com subsídios e pagar uma parte com petróleo
item.description: The federal government announced fuel tax relief measures costing an estimated R$ 7 billion per month to mitigate cost shocks from the Iran war. The economic team projected additional revenue of R$ 10 billion due to rising oil prices, but warned about the risk of exceeding the fiscal target.

item.title: Subsídios à gasolina e ao diesel são ampliados após alta do petróleo
item.description: The Lula administration expanded subsidies for gasoline and diesel following the international oil price surge, cutting taxes on gasoline and authorizing an initial R$1 per liter subsidy for diesel. These measures aim to cushion the impact of global volatility on domestic prices and account for Brazil's reliance on fuel imports.

item.title: Temer diz que preservar integridade do STF é "questão de sobrevivência"
item.description: Former President Michel Temer stated that preserving the integrity of the STF is a matter of survival for the Republic, advocating for internal resolution of conflicts between court ministers. His remarks came after decisions were suspended regarding conflicting rulings on the leadership of the Federal Police, involving ministers André Mendonça and Flávio Dino. Temer emphasized the importance of prioritizing institutions over individuals to ensure harmony among the branches of government.

item.title: Michelle convoca PL Mulher para formar “Exército Rosa” por Flávio
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro, former first lady and Senate candidate, urged PL Mulher leaders nationwide to form an 'Army of Pink' to support Flávio Bolsonaro's presidential bid. She emphasized the role of women's mobilization within the party in a video.

item.title: Santos anuncia a contratação de Everton Cebolinha, do Flamengo
item.description: Santos officially signed Everton Cebolinha from Flamengo as their fourth reinforcement this season, taking over the iconic number 7 jersey. The left winger joins with 12 appearances, one goal, and two assists this year. The team faces Atlético-MG in the Copa Sudamericana while fighting relegation in the Brasileirão.

item.title: Presidenciáveis reagem à decisão de Fachin que mantém Andrei na PF e tira Moraes do inquérito das fake news
item.description: STF president Edson Fachin kept Andrei Rodrigues in the Federal Police and removed Alexandre de Moraes from the fake news investigation, prompting reactions from presidential candidates such as Renan Santos, Romeu Zema, and Ronaldo Caiado, who criticized the internal crisis at the Supreme Court.

item.title: Arena Mané Garrincha, em Brasília, receberá a final da Copa do Brasil 2026
item.description: The Mané Garrincha Arena in Brasília was selected by the CBF to host the 2026 Copa do Brasil final, which will be played in a single match on December 6th. The decision was announced during the semifinal draw, where Atlético-MG faces Grêmio and Palmeiras plays against Vasco. The Federal District governor, Celina Leão, offered the stadium for the event, highlighting the city's infrastructure and football history.

item.title: Os argumentos de Fachin para anular a decisão de André Mendonça sobre diretor-geral da PF
item.description: Justice Edson Fachin suspended Minister André Mendonça's decision removing two Federal Police directors amid an internal Supreme Court conflict linked to Operation Compliance Zero. Mendonça had reacted to reports questioning his conduct, while the Attorney General opposed his actions. Flávio Dino later overturned the removal of the directors.

item.title: Guerra Moraes x Mendonça: o que Fachin decidiu e o que acontece agora com os ministros do STF
item.description: STF President Edson Fachin convened a plenary session for September 15 to address the institutional crisis caused by conflicting rulings from justices Alexandre de Moraes, André Mendonça, and Flávio Dino. He suspended case 16.662, which examined alleged conversations between Moraes and banker Daniel Vorcaro, and revoked the order naming Moraes as rapporteur of the 2019 Fake News Inquiry. The PGR requested the annulment of Mendonça’s proceedings against Moraes, arguing he exceeded his judicial role.

item.title: Sul-Americana: reforços fazem estreia por Santos e Atlético-MG nas quartas
item.description: Santos and Atlético-MG face off in the first leg of the Copa Sudamericana quarterfinals, missing key players like Neymar, Everson, and Cuello. The match marks Rodinei's debut with Santos and Gabriel Bontempo's call-up to the Brazilian national team. The decisive clash takes place at Vila Belmiro, with the second leg in Belo Horizonte determining who advances to the semifinals.

item.title: Governo amplia desoneração da gasolina para R$ 0,63 por litro
item.description: The federal government expanded gasoline tax relief from R$0.44 to R$0.63 per liter, impacting R$1.7 billion monthly. For ethanol, the R$0.19 per liter benefit zeroes federal taxes, totaling R$2 billion. President Lula also authorized a R$1.00 per liter subsidy for diesel, with an estimated monthly cost of R$5 billion.

item.title: A decisão que falta para Fachin retomar de vez o comando do STF
item.description: Edson Fachin took charge of the crisis at the STF by suspending conflicting decisions from André Mendonça and Flávio Dino regarding the Federal Police leadership, keeping Andrei Rodrigues and Leandro Almada in their positions. He also removed Alexandre de Moraes from handling the fake news investigation, transferring responsibility to the STF Presidency. The move weakens both Mendonça and Moraes, but it remains unclear who will handle politically sensitive cases involving the Banco Master and INSS fraud.

item.title: TRE-PR mantém propaganda que diz que Moro votou em Dino
item.description: The TRE-PR upheld an electoral advertisement claiming Sergio Moro voted in favor of Flávio Dino's nomination to the STF, ruling that the secret vote cannot be objectively verified. The decision rejected requests to remove the ad, stating there is no way to prove or disprove the direction of the vote.

item.title: Alexandre de Moraes perder o inquérito das fake news chega tarde e não estanca a hemorragia suprema
item.description: The decision by STF president Edson Fachin to move the fake news investigation from Minister Alexandre de Moraes to Minister André Mendonça comes too late to prevent the already entrenched political fallout. The crisis within the Supreme Court, heightened by revelations about Moraes’ ties to Daniel Vorcaro, keeps the judiciary in turmoil, indirectly benefiting figures like Flávio Bolsonaro. Despite attempts at internal restructuring, the STF remains weakened amid a severe legitimacy crisis.

item.title: Aliados de Mendonça comemoram decisão de Fachin que suspende procedimento da PGR
item.description: Supporters of Minister André Mendonça celebrated the decision by STF President Edson Fachin to suspend an inquiry opened by the PGR into Federal Police reports. The ruling halts an investigation involving figures close to the minister, prompting relief among Mendonça's allies.

item.title: Como demonstrou Dino, não podemos naturalizar a violência, mesmo a institucional
item.description: The text reflects on the importance of civility in politics, highlighting the role of Minister Flávio Dino and criticizing the normalization of violence, even institutional. It emphasizes that democracy requires respect and cordiality, even in the face of opponents, and draws historical parallels with Italy to illustrate party cooperation.

item.title: Supremo em crise é perigo para a democracia
item.description: Text questions power concentration in the STF and warns of risk to democracy, highlighting institutional crisis and the need for caution regarding judicial authority abuse.

item.title: Flávio compara PF do governo Lula à polícia nazista
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro criticized the Federal Police under Lula's government, comparing it to the Nazi Gestapo. He reacted to a report about an operation investigating documents linked to him, accusing the PF of exceeding its legal authority and using illegal methods.

item.title: Políticos cobram fim do sigilo de caso Banco Master e INSS
item.description: Brazilian politicians demand the end of secrecy over investigations into the Banco Master and INSS cases amid the institutional crisis at the STF. President Lula called the scandal the biggest financial crime in Brazilian history and advocated full transparency. Caiado filed a petition with the STF requesting the release of all investigations involving public officials.

item.title: Fachin retira Moraes do inquérito das fake News e assume a relatoria
item.description: Supreme Court President Edson Fachin decided to remove Minister Alexandre de Moraes from the fake news investigation, assuming the case directly. The decision preserves all previous acts by Moraes and follows a series of conflicts between ministers, including disputes over police leadership.

item.title: Os riscos que a crise do STF oferece à democracia
item.description: The Supreme Federal Court crisis, driven by tensions between ministers such as Moraes and Mendonça, undermines democracy by politicizing judicial decisions and directly affecting the 2026 electoral contest. The removal of officials tied to political figures and the lack of transparency in investigations raise concerns about the Democratic Rule of Law.

item.title: Computadores, motos e viagens; veja o que dá para comprar com R$ 31 mil do novo iPhone Duo
item.description: The iPhone Duo, Apple's first foldable phone, is priced up to R$31,000 in Brazil, exceeding the cost of some used cars and representing over a year and a half of minimum wage. The device's high price underscores economic inequality and debates on affordable consumption.

item.title: Além do cansaço: acabar com a escala 6x1 é imperativo
item.description: The PEC 221/2019 proposes reducing the workday from 44 hours, opposing the 6x1 shift and its health, safety, and gender-related impacts. With data on rising absences due to mental disorders and injuries, the text highlights the incompatibility of this shift with regulatory standards and the right to family life.

item.title: Eleições 2026: quantos ministros do STF o próximo presidente poderá indicar
item.description: The president elected in 2026 will be able to appoint at least four ministers to the STF, including the open seat after Jorge Messias' rejection and the retirements of Luiz Fux, Cármen Lúcia, and Gilmar Mendes by 2030. If additional vacancies arise, the number of appointments may increase.

item.title: Lula pede quebra de sigilo em investigações do Banco Master
item.description: President Lula called for the full breaking of secrecy in the Banco Master investigation, emphasizing transparency and criticizing selective leaks that affect the electoral dispute.

item.title: Caiado pede a Fachin abertura de sigilos sobre Banco Master e INSS
item.description: Presidential candidate Ronaldo Caiado requested the opening of investigations involving Banco Master, INSS, and other cases to the STF, claiming voters need information to decide. He criticizes lack of transparency and supports releasing PF data.

item.title: Haddad comenta pedido de explicações de Lula ao STF: “Fiquei feliz”
item.description: Fernando Haddad supported Lula's request for explanations to the STF regarding the judiciary crisis, advocating for transparency in Master case investigations. He criticized selective leaks and emphasized the need to open all inquiries to protect democratic processes. The Quaest poll shows Tarcísio leading with 42% and Haddad second with 27%.

item.title: Em momento de tensão na campanha, PT decide ir às ruas em defesa de Lula
item.description: The PT called for a national demonstration on the 13th in support of Lula's reelection, following Flávio Bolsonaro's event on September 7th. The mobilization aims to strengthen the president's project and bring people closer to the electoral debate, without a single defined format. The context includes the STF crisis and criticism of leaked information that may impact the race.

item.title: Dino: as leis devolvem cargo a Andrei; ilegal é a liminar de Mendonça
item.description: Minister Flávio Dino restored legality by reinstating Andrei Rodrigues as head of the Federal Police following a controversial judicial injunction issued by Justice Andrei Mendonça. The episode underscored disregard for legal procedures and the instrumentalization of investigations during an election period, drawing criticism toward right-wing political figures.

item.title: Quem indicou cada ministro do STF? Veja os presidentes que definiram a atual Corte
item.description: The current STF bench includes justices appointed by five presidents, with Lula being the largest appointer with four names. Presidential appointments require Senate approval after hearings. Each president defined distinct strategies for nominations over more than two decades.

item.title: PT fará mobilização nacional pró-Lula no domingo
item.description: The PT will hold a national pro-Lula mobilization on Sunday (13th) with flag displays, parades, and street outreach across various cities. Organized by state directories and social movements, the decentralized event aims to expand dialogue with the population. Participants must register through the Comitê Popular platform.

item.title: Posts sobre segurança pública crescem 50% nas redes e, pela primeira vez, Lula lidera engajamento no tema entre presidenciáveis
item.description: Between August 30 and September 7, social media posts about public security increased by 50%, reaching 3.5 million posts and 72 million interactions. For the first time, Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva leads engagement on the topic among monitored presidential candidates, linking the fight against organized crime to state presence, international cooperation, and sovereignty defense.

item.title: Delação homologada por Mendonça envolve operador de Vorcaro que fez repasses ao 'Dark Horse'
item.description: Supreme Court Minister André Mendonça approved the plea bargain agreement of Antônio Carlos Freixo Júnior, known as Mineiro. The agreement involves an operator from Vorcaro who allegedly made payments to 'Dark Horse'.

item.title: Mendonça homologa delação de empresário que fez repasses para Dark Horse
item.description: STF Minister André Mendonça approved the plea bargain of businessman Antônio Carlos Freixo Júnior, revealing financial transfers to former banker Daniel Vorcaro. The case investigates money flow and potential accounting irregularities.

item.title: Tarcísio sugere checar ficha criminal de quem protestou contra ele
item.description: São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas sarcastically suggested that protesters against his administration might have criminal records, during a visit to the Armazém Solidário. He claimed the protesters were demonstrating 'voluntarily' and that checking their criminal backgrounds would reveal their motivations. Furthermore, he criticized the Supreme Federal Court for decisions he deems legally insecure, warning this could affect public perception.

item.title: Associações de advogados e sindicatos pedem reforma do Judiciário
item.description: Over 20 organizations, including the São Paulo Bar Association, launched a manifesto calling for Judiciary reform in response to a crisis at the Supreme Court. The document proposes changes such as a Code of Conduct, term limits for ministers, and greater transparency to restore public confidence in Justice.

item.title: Superintendentes da PF dizem que recondução de Andrei restabelece estabilidade na corporação
item.description: Twenty-four regional superintendents of the Federal Police publicly supported the reinstatement of Andrei Rodrigues as director-general, stating that his management restores stability and serenity within the institution. They highlighted his career marked by defense of the institution, technical performance, and respect for the Constitution, also supporting intelligence director Leandro Amaral. The statement was released after Supreme Court Minister Flávio Dino's decision to reinstate Rodrigues.

item.title: Haddad diz que reforma tributária vai ajudar a reindustrializar SP ao acabar com a guerra fiscal
item.description: Fernando Haddad stated that the tax reform will help reindustrialize São Paulo and end fiscal wars, emphasizing a development plan focused on science, technology, and education. He also indicated intentions to review privatization contracts of Sabesp, CPTM, and 'free flow' tolls signed by Tarcísio de Freitas, without immediate revocation.

item.title: Ao vivo: Lula visita obras de VLT em Teresina
item.description: President Lula inspected VLT modernization works in Teresina, integrating his agenda in Piauí with ministers and local authorities. The schedule included meetings with Governor Rafael Fonteles and activities focused on infrastructure and educational technology.

item.title: Mendonça homologa delação de empresário responsável por 'gerar' dinheiro vivo para Daniel Vorcaro
item.description: Minister André Mendonça approved the plea bargain of Antonio Carlos Freixo Junior, 'Mineiro', who claims to have generated cash for former banker Daniel Vorcaro, used to fund the film 'Dark Horse' about Jair Bolsonaro. Mineiro stated he made seven transfers to the Havengate fund in the US between January and September 2025, totaling $12.333 million, with amounts requested by Flávio Bolsonaro.

item.title: Em campanha, candidatas celebram pedido que levou Mendonça a afastar diretor-geral da PF: 'Eu e o Partido Novo afastamos Andrei'
item.description: Partido Novo candidates celebrated the removal of PF director Andrei Rodrigues ordered by the Supreme Court. Another justice reversed the decision, reinstating him, citing the party's electoral motivation and illegitimacy in a criminal case.

item.title: Crusoé: A nova previsão eleitoral de Janones
item.description: André Janones, a federal deputy from Avante-MG, posted on X a new electoral forecast, stating that Flávio will surpass Lula by mid-September. His prediction sparked reactions, noting that neither analysts, Bolsonarists nor left-wing supporters anticipated this scenario.

item.title: Mendonça usa Alexandre de Moraes para negar motivação política em conflito no STF
item.description: STF minister André Mendonça was questioned by Lula government members regarding actions escalating the court crisis. The article highlights ministerial relationships and criticism over using Alexandre de Moraes to deny political motivation. Coverage is exclusive to subscribers, detailing the institutional conflict.

item.title: 'Virou imperador' e 'loucura': como os presidenciáveis avaliaram a decisão de Dino que recolocou Andrei à frente da PF
item.description: Right-wing presidential candidates strongly criticized Flávio Dino's decision to suspend Andrei Rodrigues' removal as head of the Federal Police, calling it an unconstitutional overreach and authoritarian act. Caiado and Zema defended Mendonça, while Renan Santos questioned the Supreme Court's institutional integrity. The crisis involves internal power struggles and PF independence.

item.title: Lula assina novas medidas que ampliam a redução de imposto da gasolina
item.description: President Lula signed measures expanding tax reductions on gasoline, ethanol, and diesel, valid for one month. The actions aim to mitigate the impact of rising oil prices and Middle East instability, eliminating taxes on ethanol and increasing subsidies for diesel. The measures do not require congressional approval and are already in effect.

item.title: Michelle Bolsonaro deve seguir script de Flávio sobre participação em debates
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro, running for the Senate in the Federal District, plans to follow her grandson Flávio Bolsonaro's strategy by skipping most debates and only attending the one hosted by Record. The move aims to avoid criticism from opponents and maintain her lead in polls, where she holds 26% of the vote. Her campaign is also avoiding debates organized by G1 and Globo.

item.title: STF deveria afastar Moraes, e afastamento de Andrei da PF já deveria ter acontecido, diz Caiado
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado called for the removal of Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes and Federal Police director Andrei Rodrigues during a radio interview. The PSD presidential candidate emphasized the need for leadership changes at the STF and PF.
